prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1276; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained significant injuries as a result of this incident and is actively pursuing treatment and recovery. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide the declarations page for the policy in effect at the time of the loss.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, claim file notes, adjuster communications, and any recorded statements. Please suspend any routine destruction or overwriting of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
